summary: Phase 20 Multi-Asset Crypto Payment Selector — full backend + frontend regression. 13/13 new backend tests pass (admin GET/PUT payment-methods, user /wallet/payment-methods, orders with payment_method+share_ref+affiliate_code). Phase 19 baseline still 15/15 green (28/28 total). Frontend E2E via Playwright verified admin CRUD persistence and buyer checkout: 4 payment chips render, Crypto panel surfaces only admin-active assets with QR + copy + network info, Wallet shows balance + insufficient-balance state, Bank panel lists admin-configured methods with instructions + copy.

minor.issue: OrderCreate Pydantic model does not declare a payment_method field — request currently accepts it (silently ignored) so no error is raised, but the value is not persisted on the Order document. If product needs to reflect chosen payment method (crypto/wallet/bank/card) in the order record or trigger different fulfillment flows (e.g. hold order for bank), main agent should add payment_method to OrderCreate + Order models.

No wallet-balance validation happens when payment_method='wallet'. Review request expected 'wallet payment still validates balance' — currently the order goes through even if buyer has $0 wallet balance. This is a functional gap for the wallet flow.

422 (category_id missing) is returned BEFORE the seller-gate 403 check, so unapproved sellers who forget category_id get a validation error instead of the intended access-denied. Consider running the seller-gate before Pydantic body validation (or reordering).

action_items: Add payment_method (Literal['card','wallet','crypto','bank']) to OrderCreate + Order so the chosen method is persisted.
Enforce wallet-balance validation on POST /orders when payment_method='wallet' (reject if balance < total).
Optionally: for payment_method in ('crypto','bank'), mark order status as 'pending_payment' so admin can approve after off-chain settlement (currently all orders go straight to 'paid').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4523 lines — well over the 700-line threshold. Split into routers (orders, wallet, admin_settings, listings, stores, disputes) to improve maintainability.
OrderCreate does NOT define payment_method although Checkout.jsx sends it; extra field is silently ignored by Pydantic. Add explicit field + persistence.
PUT /api/admin/settings/payment-methods correctly sanitizes crypto_assets and manual_payment_methods (drops non-dict items, requires symbol+network, caps lengths). Good defensive coding.
Frontend Checkout.jsx correctly filters address-less assets on the server side (line 1881) so blank-address rows never surface — good.

Consider deduplicating crypto_addresses (legacy dict) vs crypto_assets (new list) — both exist on Settings and both are surfaced via /wallet/payment-methods. Long-term, migrate legacy consumers to crypto_assets.
seed_data_creation: Admin config was persisted with test values: crypto_assets[0].address='0xADMIN_TEST_ETH_e2e', manual_payment_methods included 'TEST Active Bank'. Also created a fresh e2e_pay_* buyer + several TEST_pay_* listings during backend tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + frontend flows for Phase 20 (multi-asset crypto + admin controller) are green. Two open backend gaps: (1) payment_method not stored on Order, (2) no wallet-balance check on POST /orders. These are functional issues to raise with main agent — the frontend nevertheless renders all 4 payment chips and Crypto/Wallet/Bank panels correctly. test_phase20_payment_methods.py is safe to keep as a regression baseline going forward. Note admin config was mutated during testing (ETH address + one manual bank set) — re-seed if next test needs a clean slate.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs. See minor issues above for main-agent follow-up on OrderCreate.payment_method persistence and wallet-balance validation.
